versions.subject: Added the sigma rules per OS
versions.detection:
selection:
  CommandLine|contains:
    - 'lastlog'
condition: selection
versions.spl: CommandLine="*lastlog*"

versions.subject: additional changes to split processname and commandline
versions.detection:
selection_1:
  ProcessName|contains:
    - '*/lastlog'
selection_2:
  CommandLine|contains:
    - "'x:0:'"
selection_3:
  ProcessName|contains:
    - '*/cat'
  CommandLine|contains:
    - '/etc/passwd'
    - '/etc/sudoers'
selection_4:
  ProcessName|contains:
    - '*/id'
selection_5:
  ProcessName|contains:
    - '*/lsof'
  CommandLine|contains:
    - '-u'
condition: 1 of them
versions.spl: ProcessName="*/lastlog*" OR CommandLine="*'x:0:'*" OR (ProcessName="*/cat*" CommandLine IN ("*/etc/passwd*", "*/etc/sudoers*")) OR ProcessName="*/id*" OR (ProcessName="*/lsof*" CommandLine="*-u*")
